headline: A classic Gulf sailboat class holds its world championship
what: The Fish is a classic one-design sailboat with deep roots in Gulf Coast racing. Its world championship sails on Pensacola Bay this weekend.
why: A piece of Gulf sailing history a passing cruiser would never know was happening. Same weekend as the Flying Scot Rally on Choctawhatchee Bay.
todo: Watch from the water and give the race area room if you're crossing Pensacola Bay.

headline: Baytowne Marina rolls out a Looper docking special
what: Discounted transient dockage for Great Loopers, member fuel pricing, a free pump-out with fuel, and no cancellation fees when weather holds you up.
why: Fall is when Loopers head down the Gulf. AGLCA members get an extra 10% off dockage and the Marina Bar & Grill.
todo: Show your Looper ID or fly your AGLCA burgee at check-in. Book at 888-670-0935.
